name: VADER
author: L'Cronx
summary: An orbit-based vector synth: an orbiter travels a shape (built-in, maths, or your own SVG, OBJ, PNG, JPG) or one of 27 modes across four corners. Each corner plays overtone generators, one of 14 voices or a WAV sample, with its own envelope. Two timbres, arpeggiator, effects; its screen runs on your phone via a QR code.
